title: Deduplicate keeping the last occurrence
prompt: Implement `std::vector<std::string> dedupe_last(const std::vector<std::string>& v)` removing duplicates so each value appears once — at the position of its LAST occurrence, preserving overall order. Example: {"a","b","a","c"} becomes {"b","a","c"}. A single index map plus one pass is enough.

tests.name: basic
tests.hint: "a" survives at its last position; earlier copy is dropped.

tests.name: no-duplicates
all-same
tests.hint: The last occurrence is also the only survivor.
